description: An ESP32-C3 dev board (single-core RISC-V, Wi-Fi + Bluetooth LE). Legs are labeled by silkscreen number, not raw GPIO number, except RX/TX (UART0) which keep their named labels.
how_to_use: Peripherals (I2C, SPI, UART) can each be mapped to nearly any GPIO in software (the ESP32's GPIO matrix), so no bus pin is hardware-fixed the way it is on an AVR board — only RX/TX (UART0, used for USB flashing/Serial Monitor) are excluded by default. ADC-capable pins for this variant aren't catalogued yet — verify before relying on analogRead-specific substitution.
